sloka: मा रुदो देवि शोकेन मा भूत् ते मनसो ऽप्रियम् ।शचीव पत्या शक्रेण भर्त्रा नाथवती ह्यसि ।। ५.३९.५२।।।।
transliteration: mā rudo devi śokena mā bhūt te manaso 'priyam ।śacīva patyā śakreṇa bhartrā nāthavatī hyasi ।। 5.39.52।।।।

translations.english: "O devi weep no more.Entertain no unpleasant thoughts.You have a great husband, just as Sachi has her lord Indra.
